moves.name: Arm Swing
moves.description: The basis for all combos, it is a simple short range starting move. Fast and effective to get the job done.
moves.quote: The basis for all combos, it is a simple short range starting move. Fast and effective to get the job done.

moves.name: Kousengan - Eye Beam
moves.description: A nice fast move. You can use it as the next part of a combo after the idle B, or to poke an unexpecting adversary. There isn't too much lag time afterwards so it's a safe poking move to rely on.
moves.quote: A nice fast move. You can use it as the next part of a combo after the idle B, or to poke an unexpecting adversary. There isn't too much lag time afterwards so it's a safe poking move to rely on.

moves.name: Upward Kick
moves.description: Piccolo's air launcher move. Use this when you want to kick someone upwards for an aerial combo. It's a very fast move so feel free to use it on its own or integrate it into a combo.
moves.quote: Piccolo's air launcher move. Use this when you want to kick someone upwards for an aerial combo.

moves.name: Quick Knee
moves.description: The character change move. Don't rely on this too much unless you really need to finish off a character that is almost dead.
moves.quote: The character change move. Don't rely on this too much unless you really need to finish off a character that is almost dead.

moves.name: Aerial Arm Swing
moves.description: Combo filler to be used after the Up B. It has a short reach so you have to be close for it to connect.
moves.quote: Combo filler to be used after the Up B. It has a short reach so you have to be close for it to connect.

moves.name: Bakurikimaha - Exploding Powerful Demon Wave
moves.description: This is Piccolo's hardest hitting attack. However it has significant lag time after it is used and knocks your opponent down, so it is best reserved for ending a combo. If you miss when using this move, Piccolo is wide open to a counterattack.
moves.quote: This is Piccolo's hardest hitting attack. However it has significant lag time after it is used and knocks your opponent down, so it is best reserved for ending a combo.

moves.name: Nobiru ude - Expanding Arm
moves.description: Piccolo extends his arm forward to bring the fight to him. This is an excellent surprise attack, poke, and combo extender all in one package.
moves.quote: Piccolo extends his arm forward to bring the fight to him. This is an excellent surprise attack, poke, and combo extender all in one package.

moves.name: Kuchikarakikouha - Energy Wave from the Mouth
moves.description: An anti-air attack that fires at a 45-50 degree angle. This is an excellent move to ground those pesky airborne fighters.
moves.quote: An anti-air attack that fires at a 45-50 degree angle. This is an excellent move to ground those pesky airborne fighters like Lenalee, Eve, and Jaguar.

moves.name: Tsuno Beam - Antenna Beam
moves.description: The guard breaker move. Use it to help any shy turtlers get into the fight.
moves.quote: The guard breaker move. Use it to help any shy turtlers get into the fight.

moves.name: Delayed Air Fireball
moves.description: Piccolo leaves a purple fireball in the air. It will activate after either 2 seconds pass or an enemy approaches it.
moves.quote: Piccolo leaves a purple fireball in the air. It will activate after either 2 seconds pass or an enemy approaches it. Just think of it as a mobile air mine.
